text.en:
Kills with this weapon create a <strand/>'Teeming Nest'. Killing an enemy within 30 meters of a Teeming Nest will instead spawn a <strand/>Threadling at the enemy's location.

Teeming Nests spawn <strand/>Threadlings every 5 seconds and last for 17.5 seconds at base. Nests lose 6.7% of their health per second after being at full health for 1.5 seconds. 

Nests can be targeted by Service of Luzaku's healing shots, which heal them for 11.5% HP each shot. Landing 6 healing shots on a Teeming Nest fully restores its health.

<strand/>Threadlings spawned from Teeming Nests interact with Strand Fragments, count as weapon damage, can trigger Armor Mods, and benefit from Empowering Buffs.
